name: Daeliron
source:
What do you do when your lifelong dream is to become a druid mage, but you possess absolutely no magical abilities?

Eve arrives at the Daeliron Academy of Magical Arts to earn the title of Master Alchemist and, at the same time, turn her dream into reality. But mages are born, not made, and attempting the impossible could lead to unpredictable consequences.

Dreams are all well and good, but you can't forget about the bustling life around you! Studies, friends, enemies, and the constant trials thrown your way can seriously distract you from your original goal. What awaits our heroine: the fun-filled life of an ordinary magic academy student, or an unknown path that could just as easily bring her true happiness as completely destroy her life?

Just how far Eve is willing to go in pursuit of her dream is entirely up to you.
translation:
当你一生的梦想是成为一名德鲁伊法师，但你完全没有魔法能力时，你会怎么做？

伊芙来到戴利隆魔法艺术学院，获得炼金术大师的称号，同时将她的梦想变成现实。但法师是天生的，而不是后天培养的，尝试不可能的事情可能会导致不可预测的后果。

梦想是美好的，但你不能忘记周围熙熙攘攘的生活！学习、朋友、敌人以及不断出现的考验都会严重分散你对最初目标的注意力。等待着我们的女主人公的是：普通魔法学院学生的充满乐趣的生活，还是一条既能轻易给她带来真正的幸福，又能彻底摧毁她生活的未知道路？

夏娃愿意为了她的梦想走多远完全取决于你。
